statement: Off-axis shear leaves the determinant equal to lambda*b*b.
statement_lean:
theorem gradient_determinant (lambda b shearY shearZ : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det (gradientField lambda b shearY shearZ) = lambda * b * b
assumptions: Exactly the parameters and hypotheses in the full Lean statement.
limitations: Declared finite kinematics only; no formal derivative, integration, triangulation, floating-point or physical equilibrium refinement; no biological claim.

statement: Positive mean/length, -1<a<1 and 0<=S<=L imply positive local stretch.
statement_lean:
theorem positive_stretch_on_interval (m a L S : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (haLower : -1 < a) (haUpper : a < 1)
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hSL : S ≤ L) : 0 < stretch m a L S
assumptions: Exactly the parameters and hypotheses in the full Lean statement.
limitations: Declared finite kinematics only; no formal derivative, integration, triangulation, floating-point or physical equilibrium refinement; no biological claim.

statement: Positive lambda and b=1/sqrt(lambda) give positive b and determinant one, for arbitrary shear entries.
statement_lean:
theorem pointwise_isochoric_gradient (lambda shearY shearZ : ℝ)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda) :
    0 < transverse lambda ∧
      Matrix.det (gradientField lambda (transverse lambda) shearY shearZ) = 1
assumptions: Exactly the parameters and hypotheses in the full Lean statement.
limitations: Declared finite kinematics only; no formal derivative, integration, triangulation, floating-point or physical equilibrium refinement; no biological claim.

statement: The declared nonuniform field has positive b and determinant one throughout the stated interval.
statement_lean:
theorem nonuniform_isochoric_on_interval (m a L S shearY shearZ : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (haLower : -1 < a) (haUpper : a < 1)
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hSL : S ≤ L) :
    0 < transverse (stretch m a L S) ∧
      Matrix.det (gradientField (stretch m a L S)
        (transverse (stretch m a L S)) shearY shearZ) = 1
assumptions: Exactly the parameters and hypotheses in the full Lean statement.
limitations: Declared finite kinematics only; no formal derivative, integration, triangulation, floating-point or physical equilibrium refinement; no biological claim.

statement: For positive endpoint square-root ratio r, the algebraic straight-cell volume error has the stated nonnegative factorization.
statement_lean:
theorem straight_cell_error_factorization (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    straightCellRatio r - 1 =
      (r - 1) ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 3 * r + 1) / (6 * r ^ 2)
assumptions: Exactly the parameters and hypotheses in the full Lean statement.
limitations: Declared finite kinematics only; no formal derivative, integration, triangulation, floating-point or physical equilibrium refinement; no biological claim.

statement: For r>0 the algebraic straight-cell volume ratio is at least one; this does not certify a mesh implementation.
